name: Get a daily AI news brief from 50+ curated feeds, tagged by category and ranked by your interests

parameters.content:
## Daily category-tagged news brief → email

Pick the topics you care about and get one ranked brief every morning, pulled from a built-in catalog of 50+ quality feeds and grouped by category.

### How it works
Set your categories (ai, tech, startups, jobs, dev, security, product, science, business, marketing, world) or use all. A Code node expands the baked-in catalog, a native HTTP Request node fetches every feed in those categories, and a Code node parses the results and tags each article with its category, keeps only recent items, and de-duplicates by link. A single AI call drops noise, picks the most relevant stories against your interests while keeping your category mix, rewrites tight headlines, and scores importance. The picks are grouped by category and emailed to you.

### Setup
- Edit the config node: categories, your interests, look-back window, and the send-to address.
- Add credentials in the canvas: Anthropic on the ranking HTTP node and Gmail on the send node.
- The Schedule Trigger runs daily; change the hour to taste.

### Customization
Edit the catalog in the expand node to add or remove feeds and categories, widen the window for a weekly edition, or swap the email for Slack or Telegram.

Built by **nocode.expert** — done-for-you automation and AI workflows. https://nocode.expert

## 1. Fetch & tag
Pick categories in the config. The HTTP node fetches every feed in those categories from the built-in 50+ catalog; the parse node tags each article by category, keeping recent, de-duplicated items.

## 2. Rank vs your interests
One AI call drops noise, picks the most relevant stories across categories, and scores importance while keeping the tags.

## 3. Email, grouped by tag
Picks are grouped by category and emailed. Swap for Slack or Telegram if you prefer.
